title: On spectral Turán theorems: confirming a conjecture of Guiduli and two problems of Nikiforov
summary: Let $G$ be an $n$-vertex graph, and let $λ(G)$ and $λ_n(G)$ denote the largest and smallest eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix. Write $e(G)$ for the number of edges of $G$, $d(G)=2e(G)/n$ for its average degree, and $T_r(n)$ for the $r$-partite Turán graph on $n$ vertices. We prove four sharp results in spectral Turán theory. First, we confirm Guiduli's spectral dense-neighborhood conjecture (1996) in a stronger form: if $λ(G)\ge λ(T_r(n))$, then either $G\cong T_r(n)$, or there exists a vertex $v$ such that $λ(G[N(v)]) > λ(T_{r-1}(d(v)))$.
